rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=16, wu_n_outer=1, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0007, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-11 (one knob vs iter-10 best). NUMBERS n_bands sweep(n_outer1): 6->RMSE0.005542, 8->0.005260, 12->0.005089 (iter-10 FIRST hr>0 = 0.0240, PSNR36.54) -- MONOTONE RMSE decline, just cleared the 0.005214 baseline. FAILURE MODE: step-1 fidelity still band-resolution-limited; each finer partition drops RMSE. SSIM eased 0.938->0.933 (finer bands trade a hair of SSIM for lower RMSE, which is what hr rewards). ONE KNOB: wu_n_bands 12 -> 16 (n_outer/thresh/motion locked). HYPOTHESIS: if the monotone n_bands->lower-RMSE trend continues, 16 bands raise hr above 0.024; if RMSE plateaus/rises (bands too narrow -> per-band back-projection noise, or the per-radius sigmoid weights saturate), the n_bands optimum brackets in (12,16) and I bisect, locking the classical Wu operating point. Budget: 16 bands ~ 1.3x iter-10, still seconds.
